title: The capability sheet
summary: The nav is hero C's row of ruled cells (tracked-caps menu cells, a SHEET 00/14 cell and an outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗ cell). CAPABILITIES opens SHEET 00, laid out on C's own sheet anatomy rather than as columns of links. A selector stack on cols 1–3 (the selected cell inverts, like every C tab) runs lettered leaders into FIG. 0.1, the corrected three-piece mark exploded at exact 30° on cols 4–8, where one red plane lands on the selected capability's piece. The spec column on cols 9–12 lists that capability's four services, the datum note (the System Audit, joined to the drawing's datum by a leader) and the shared door pair.

reference.borrowed: Bird's header is one continuous strip of 1px-bordered cells: a logo cell, short menu cells, a long empty cell in the middle and a solid filled action cell closing the right end. The nav reads as a ruled table row, not floating links.
reference.kelwin: Bird's cells sit on the 12-column gutter lines exactly as in hero C: lockup on cols 1–2, five Mona 500 tracked-caps menu cells and a mono SHEET 00/14 cell where Bird's empty cell was. Bird's filled action becomes the founder's outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗ cell on cols 11–12 (a 1px --fg frame, inverting on hover), and Bird's 'Log in' is dropped. The open tab inverts. The row continues downward as a graphite drawing sheet with C's sheet anatomy: three selector cells (A·C-01 Narrative Systems, B·C-02 GTM Infrastructure, C·C-03 GTM Intelligence, each with a mono 'Kn · Layer n/3' line, an uppercase wide 20px title and a descriptor), FIG. 0.1 (the 152-unit master mark's three solid pieces exploded on one axis over a dashed datum footprint, with Δ 88U explode dimensions), and a spec column of 48px cell rows with C-0n.n IDs that swaps with the selection. Bird's filled action cell reappears where it converts, as the red 'C-00 · Fixed scope · 10 WD / Initiate System Audit ↗' door beside a ruled Contact cell (the shared C door pair). The sheet closes on the shared C band: key plus the segmented title block 'Sheet 00/14 | FIG. 0.1 | Rev C | Kelwin/GTM'. The column lines continue over the film below, as in hero C.

motion: entrance (drafting order, --ease-inout): the frame verticals and crosshairs fade in (300ms), the nav cell rules draw top-down in order (40ms stagger) and the sheet rules draw in raster order (40ms stagger). The column lines over the film draw down at 900ms.

entrance: the selector cells fade in top to bottom (80ms stagger). FIG. 0.1 plots via stroke-dashoffset, base piece first and then upward (K3, K2, K1, 1.4s each, 140ms apart). The leaders and labels appear at ~1.7s, the mono IDs type on at 24ms per character in raster order, and the spec rows, door pair and band fade in by 1.3s.

demo: the red plane drops onto K1 at ~2.0s (opacity plus an 8px settle), with selector A inverted and the spec column on C-01. At ~3.2s it steps to K2 (600ms): selector B inverts, its leader and key entry go --fg, and the spec column cross-fades to C-02's services.
ambient: only the cool night film under the drafting overlay (hero C's calibration). Nothing else loops.

interaction: hovering or focusing a selector cell moves the red plane to its piece and swaps the spec column. Hovering a nav cell, service row or the 'All of …' row inverts it (--fg fill, --bg text). The outlined AUDIT REQUEST cell inverts and its ↗ moves 2px up-right, the red door deepens to --accent-hover, and an X/Y cursor readout appears on the frame edge below the sheet.
on the live site: CAPABILITIES opens on hover or focus (aria-expanded) and closes on Esc. Reduced motion shows the fully plotted final state (C-02 selected).
notes: Coherence pass: recomposed from four callout cells around a centre drawing (which shared nav-A's three-column skeleton) into C's sheet anatomy, a master–detail sheet: selector stack → drawing → spec column → band. The iso drawing is generated (scratchpad caudit/build_nav.mjs) from the corrected mark: an exact 30° projection painted bottom-up so higher pieces occlude correctly, with 16-unit plates and an 88-unit explode step. Red: the plane is the sheet's one red element and the C-00 door is the action cell. The nav repeats hero C's bar metric for metric (Mona 500 11px caps at .18em, a SHEET cell, an outlined audit cell). Stage is 800px; the film strip under the sheet uses hero C's calibration and shows a seated colleague and a man seen from behind.
